title: AutoConnect soft-matte prototype
scope: Site 517 styling and integration feasibility. Preserve earlier within-dimension weights. Dimension weights 34/33/33 support a diagnostic overall score only. Default acceptance checks each dimension. Operator scores are design judgments, not validation with workers aged 50 to 60. Performance scores assess measured prototype costs, not target-tablet FPS. Declare budgets and representative workload before review.
